headline: Cardano Token Holders Oppose $4 Million Conference Budget Request
summary: Cardano holders have voted heavily against a $4 million request by the Cardano Foundation to fund its 2027 flagship conference, while a developer tools proposal faces little opposition.
why: Cardano is a public blockchain platform that uses the native cryptocurrency ADA for transaction execution and governance.

impacts.name: Cardano
impacts.why: Token holders voted against funding the foundation's 2027 conference budget proposal.
